text:
`python3 -m unittest` now passes: 16 tests, all OK. I only changed code in `catalog/`, and the tests are untouched.

- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` now converts the year to an `int`.
- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from a module that doesn't exist, so it now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` is 5, matching the lending-policy comment and the tests.
- **`fees.py`:** the late fee now multiplies days by the daily rate. It was adding them.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events because of an off-by-one in the slice. It now returns exactly the last `n`.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books` was missing the third title, so I added `Emma` (Austen, 1815, 1 copy). The tests and docstring only fix the title; the author, year and copy count are my choice.
